+       "  '    return this.localOperations.debitWallet(params.externalBookingId, params.userId, params.setupToken, params.amountToDeductFromWallet);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  /** Shared by create (pay now) and retry-payment (pay later). */\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private buildExternalPaymentOrderNotes(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    kind: ExternalBookingKind,\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    booking: Pick<IExternalBooking, 'appointmentType' | 'providerType'>\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '  ): Record<string, unknown> {\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (kind === 'diagnostics') {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      return {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    return {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private async finalizeExternalPaymentSettlement(params: {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    userId: string; bookingId: string; grossAmount: number; discountAmount: number; couponCode?: string;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    walletAlreadyApplied: number; attemptUseWalletBalance?: boolean; orderNotes: Record<string, unknown>;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }): Promise<ExternalBookingPaymentInitResponse> {\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    const setup = await this.localOperations.beginSetup(params.bookingId, { _id: params.userId, userType: 'user' });\\n" +\n` +

+       "  '    let failed = true;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    let linked: IExternalBooking;\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    let payment: Awaited<ReturnType<PaymentService['createDirectPaidTransaction']>>;\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '    let response: ExternalBookingPaymentInitResponse;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    try {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const gross = bookingMoneyPaise(params.grossAmount) - bookingMoneyPaise(params.discountAmount);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const prior = setup.localEffects!.walletDebitedPaise;\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "      if (gross < prior) throw new AppError({ status: 409, code: 'EXTERNAL_BOOKING_RECONCI`... 2174 more characters,
+     name: 'foreign customer and unsigned cancellation have no authority'
+   },
+   {
+     error: 'AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: The input was expected to not match the regular expression /\\b(?:import|require|eval)\\s*\\(|\\bprocess\\./. Input:\n' +
+       '\n' +

+       "  '  matched: boolean;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  action:\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    | 'ignored'\\n" +\n` +
+       `  "    | 'updated'\\n" +\n` +
+       `  "    | 'cancelled'\\n" +\n` +
+       `  "    | 'completed'\\n" +\n` +
+       `  "    | 'rescheduled';\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '  reason?: string;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  externalBookingId?: string;\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '}\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  'export class ExternalBookingService {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private readonly localOperations = new ExternalBookingLocalOperations();\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private readonly defaultIntegration: ExternalIntegration =\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    CONFIG.EXTERNAL_BOOKING_DEFAULT_INTEGRATION || 'labstack';\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  constructor(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    private externalBookingRepository: ExternalBookingRepository,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '  ) {}\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private resolveIntegration(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    integration?: string | null\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  ): ExternalIntegration {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const resolved = (integration || this.defaultIntegration) as ExternalIntegration;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    this.ensureSupportedIntegration(resolved);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    return resolved;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private getDiagnosticsProviderClient(integration: ExternalIntegration) {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '      ? this.healthiansService\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      : this.labstackService;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private async sendExternalBookingEmailNotification(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    booking: IExternalBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    template: ExternalBookingEmailTemplate,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    options: { oldBookingDate?: string; oldBookingTime?: string } = {}\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  ): Promise<void> {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    try {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const recipients = new Set<string>();\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (booking.patientEmail?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(booking.patientEmail.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const user = await this.userRepository.findById(booking.userId);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (user?.email?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(user.email.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (!recipients.size) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        return;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const content = buildExternalBookingEmailContent({\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        template,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        oldBookingDate: options.oldBookingDate,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        oldBookingTime: options.oldBookingTime,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        userName: booking.patientName || user?.name,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      await this.emailService.sendEmail({\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        to: Array.from(recipients),\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        template,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private async markExternalBookingConfirmationPending(booking: IExternalBooking, _message: string): Promise<IExternalBooking> {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    // The attempt adapter already persisted the unknown result. Never rewrite a concurrent cancellation.\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const current = await this.externalBookingRepository.findById(String(booking._id));\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (!current) throw new AppError({ status: 404, code: 'EXTERNAL_BOOKING_NOT_FOUND', message: 'External booking not found' });\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '    return publicExternalBooking(current as IExternalBooking);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private isRecoverablePaidBookingTimeout(error: unknown): boolean {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const message =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      error instanceof Error ? error.message.toLowerCase() : String(error).toLowerCase();\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    return message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('status code 5');\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private async recoverPaidExternalBookingIfNeeded(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    booking: IExternalBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    paymentRecordId?: string\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  ): Promise<ExternalBookingPaymentInitResponse | null> {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    if (!paymentRecordId) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return null;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const paymentRecord = await this.paymentRepository.findById(paymentRecordId);\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (!paymentRecord || paymentRecord.context !== 'external_booking') {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      return null;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (paymentRecord.status !== 'paid') {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      return null;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    logger.info('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery check', {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      bookingStatus: booking.status,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      bookingPaymentStatus: booking.paymentStatus,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      paymentStatus: paymentRecord.status,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      isProcessed: paymentRecord.isProcessed,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    try {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const recovered = await this.paymentService.recoverExternalBookingPayment(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRecord\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      );\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "      logger.info('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery success', {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '        bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking: recovered.entity as IExternalBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRequired: false,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        walletDeductedAmount: Number(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        fulfillmentState: await this.localOperations.fulfillmentState(String(booking._id)),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    } catch (error) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (!this.isRecoverablePaidBookingTimeout(error)) {\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "        logger.error('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery failed', {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '          bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        throw error;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const pendingBooking =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        await this.markExternalBookingConfirmationPending(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          booking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        );\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking: pendingBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRequired: false,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        walletDeductedAmount: Number(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "        fulfillmentState: 'pending_confirmation',\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '  private resolveIntegration(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    integration?: string | null\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    const resolved = (integration || this.defaultIntegration) as ExternalIntegration;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    this.ensureSupportedIntegration(resolved);\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private async sendExternalBookingEmailNotification(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    booking: IExternalBooking,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    try {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const recipients = new Set<string>();\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (booking.patientEmail?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(booking.patientEmail.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const user = await this.userRepository.findById(booking.userId);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (user?.email?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(user.email.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (!recipients.size) {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        template,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        oldBookingTime: options.oldBookingTime,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '  private async markExternalBookingConfirmationPending(booking: IExternalBooking, _message: string): Promise<IExternalBooking> {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    // The attempt adapter already persisted the unknown result. Never rewrite a concurrent cancellation.\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const current = await this.externalBookingRepository.findById(String(booking._id));\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (!current) throw new AppError({ status: 404, code: 'EXTERNAL_BOOKING_NOT_FOUND', message: 'External booking not found' });\\n" +\n` +

+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  private isRecoverablePaidBookingTimeout(error: unknown): boolean {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const message =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      error instanceof Error ? error.message.toLowerCase() : String(error).toLowerCase();\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '  ): Promise<ExternalBookingPaymentInitResponse | null> {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    if (!paymentRecordId) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return null;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const paymentRecord = await this.paymentRepository.findById(paymentRecordId);\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (paymentRecord.status !== 'paid') {\\n" +\n` +

+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    logger.info('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery check', {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        paymentRecord\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      );\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "      logger.info('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery success', {\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '        bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        booking: recovered.entity as IExternalBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRequired: false,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        walletDeductedAmount: Number(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        fulfillmentState: await this.localOperations.fulfillmentState(String(booking._id)),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    } catch (error) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (!this.isRecoverablePaidBookingTimeout(error)) {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '          bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        throw error;\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '      const pendingBooking =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        await this.markExternalBookingConfirmationPending(\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        );\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking: pendingBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRequired: false,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        walletDeductedAmount: Number(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "        fulfillmentState: 'pending_confirmation',\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    integration?: string | null\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    const resolved = (integration || this.defaultIntegration) as ExternalIntegration;\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    try {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const recipients = new Set<string>();\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (booking.patientEmail?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(booking.patientEmail.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const user = await this.userRepository.findById(booking.userId);\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (user?.email?.trim()) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        recipients.add(user.email.trim());\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      if (!recipients.size) {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        return;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const content = buildExternalBookingEmailContent({\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        template,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        oldBookingDate: options.oldBookingDate,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        oldBookingTime: options.oldBookingTime,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        userName: booking.patientName || user?.name,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      await this.emailService.sendEmail({\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        htmlBody: content.htmlBody,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    } catch (error) {\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '        bookingId: booking._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        template,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      });\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    // The attempt adapter already persisted the unknown result. Never rewrite a concurrent cancellation.\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    const current = await this.externalBookingRepository.findById(String(booking._id));\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    if (!current) throw new AppError({ status: 404, code: 'EXTERNAL_BOOKING_NOT_FOUND', message: 'External booking not found' });\\n" +\n` +

+       "  '    const message =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      error instanceof Error ? error.message.toLowerCase() : String(error).toLowerCase();\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '      return null;\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '    const paymentRecord = await this.paymentRepository.findById(paymentRecordId);\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "    logger.info('[ExternalBooking] paid booking recovery check', {\\n" +\n` +

+       "  '      paymentTransactionId: paymentRecord._id,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      bookingStatus: booking.status,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      bookingPaymentStatus: booking.paymentStatus,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      paymentStatus: paymentRecord.status,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      isProcessed: paymentRecord.isProcessed,\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '      );\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +

+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      const pendingBooking =\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        await this.markExternalBookingConfirmationPending(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          booking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        );\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '      return {\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        booking: pendingBooking,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        paymentRequired: false,\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        walletDeductedAmount: Number(\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '          paymentRecord.notes?.walletDeductedAmount ?? 0\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '        ),\\n' +\n" +
+       `  "        fulfillmentState: 'pending_confirmation',\\n" +\n` +
+       "  '      };\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '    }\\n' +\n" +
+       "  '  }\\n' +\n" +
